text.title: claude-messages-api Examples
text.summary: Worked code for the request/response structure, multi-turn history, vision (base64, URL, PDF) and the three streaming patterns, with the SSE event format reference.

section.title: Messages API request, parameters, and response structure
section.p: Basic request structure, parameters table, response object fields, content block types, and multi-turn conversation pattern.

example.code:
import anthropic
client = anthropic.Anthropic()
message = client.messages.create( model="claude-sonnet-4-20250514", max_tokens=1024, system="You are an expert on Specification-Driven Development. Be concise.", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "What are the key phases of SDD?"}] ) print(message.content[0].text)

messages = [ {"role": "user", "content": "What is SDD?"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "SDD (Specification-Driven Development) is..."}, {"role": "user", "content": "How does it compare to TDD?"} ] response = client.messages.create(model="claude-sonnet-4-20250514", max_tokens=1024, messages=messages) # Append full content list, not just text messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": response.content})

section.title: Vision: images and PDFs
section.p: Image input from base64 and URL, multiple images in one message, PDF document type; supported formats and size limits.

list.item: JPEG / PNG / GIF / WebP: max 20MB each

section.title: Streaming: text_stream, events, async
section.p: Three streaming patterns: text_stream for simple output, event-based for tools and fine-grained control, async streaming for concurrent pipelines; SSE event format reference.

example.code: with client.messages.stream( model="claude-sonnet-4-20250514", max_tokens=1024, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Write a poem about AI"}] ) as stream: for text in stream.text_stream: print(text, end="", flush=True) # Get usage stats after streaming completes final = stream.get_final_message() print(f"\nTokens: {final.usage.input_tokens} in, {final.usage.output_tokens} out")
example.note: Use stream.get_final_message() when usage stats are needed — they are not available from individual chunks.

example.code:
import asyncio import anthropic
async_client = anthropic.AsyncAnthropic()
async def stream_response(): async with async_client.messages.stream( model="claude-sonnet-4-20250514", max_tokens=1024, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}] ) as stream: async for text in stream.text_stream: print(text, end="", flush=True)
asyncio.run(stream_response())

section.title: SSE event format
section.p: Raw SSE format for custom transport implementations:

list.item: message_start: message metadata (id, model, usage placeholder)
content_block_start: new content block begins (type: text or tool_use)
